## Historical audit: H0040

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane0/codex_parallel_05_lane0_I_r1/infer_logs/claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegation/turn_1/trajs.json`. Event references below are to its main agent; offsets are observation character ranges.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | **Inferred**, because the original task request is not shown: enable recursive agent delegation and return a child’s result to its caller. The pre-change handler routed orchestration to a single agent (event 13, [0,23565)); a mock expected three provider calls and continuation but observed one (event 27, [0,665)). |
| Autonomous exploration | The student searched and read the handler, provider contracts, registry and tests, then built a mock reproduction (events 6–7, 10–23, 24–27). Its first reproduction was interrupted by a CommonJS top-level-await transform error; renaming it to `.mts` exposed the missing continuation (events 25–27). |
| Actual changes | The student added recursive execution, accumulated child text, tool-result continuation, cycle checks and a 20-turn limit; the Anthropic adapter gained streamed tool-call parsing and structured continuation handling (events 30–32, [0,6114), [0,4127); diff in event 41, [0,29746)). Three files were committed as `a255180` (event 45, [0,721)). The patch was not empty. |
| Visible validation | Type-check passed after generating missing version metadata (events 33–35). A mock verified accumulated text, matching tool-use ID and cleanup **after stream completion** (events 42–43). Handler tests showed six passes and one failure: the controller was still present immediately after response return (event 39, [0,10774)). Provider tests ran no tests because an existing OpenAI test failed transformation on `await` in a non-async function (event 41, [0,29746)). |
| Outcome | **Partial correctness, formally not solved:** supplied inventory reports 6/7 fail-to-pass and 31/31 pass-to-pass; the detailed formal failing case is not supplied. The successful session termination and commit do not establish full task success (top-level metadata, [0,2724)). |
| Teacher input | The inventory lists available hint files and one teacher check, but no captured teacher text or delivered online event is included in these observations. Receipt and adoption are therefore **unknown**; file availability alone is not evidence of either. The Claude API skill text was delivered (events 1–3), but is not identified as teacher feedback. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, test continuation payloads and resource lifecycle at the specific times required, not merely eventual cleanup. Task-specific details include the `delegate_task` schema and Anthropic streaming conversion. The formal failure’s identity and whether deeper recursion, parallel tool calls, or live provider behavior work remain unresolved; the visible mock alone does not establish them. This is a code task, not a scene audit.
